Building a Go/SOAP API replacement for browser-based QA, with SQS, DynamoDB transactions, durable write intents and reconciliation of uncertain external submissions.
Built an isolated Windows VM and Docker lab with synthetic data to enable reproducible vendor API integration testing without access to production PHI.
